title: Fun at the School Fair
passage:
Every October, our school holds a fair for students and their families. Last Friday, my class helped set up a game booth in the schoolyard. When I was younger, I used to be too shy to talk to customers, but now I really enjoy it.

"Excuse me, how do I play this game?" a boy asked at our booth.

"It's easy for you to try," I said. "Just throw three rings and try to land them on the bottles."

He wasn't as lucky as the girl before him, but he still had fun. My friend Tina ran the food booth next to ours. She used to make cookies with her grandmother every weekend, so she baked dozens of cookies for the fair.

"These cookies are as delicious as the ones at the bakery downtown!" a teacher said happily.

By noon, long lines formed in front of the food booths, and the smell of popcorn filled the air. It was hard for us to find a place to sit, so we shared a table with another class.

In the afternoon, our booth earned enough money to buy new books for the library. "I used to think fairs were just for fun," our teacher said, "but they can also teach us about teamwork and hard work."

At the end of the day, we were tired but proud. It wasn't as hard as we expected, and everyone agreed the fair was a great success.

Long lines formed in front of the booths.

grammar: used to + 原形動詞：表示過去的習慣或狀態，現在已不再如此。例如：I used to be too shy to talk to customers, but now I really enjoy it.（used to be 表示過去害羞、現在不同）；Tina used to make cookies with her grandmother every weekend.
as + 原級(形容詞/副詞) + as：表示「跟…一樣」，否定 not as...as 表示「不如…」。例如：These cookies are as delicious as the ones at the bakery downtown.（同等比較）；He wasn't as lucky as the girl before him.（否定同等比較，表示「不如」）。
It's/It was + 形容詞 + for + 某人 + to V：表示「對某人而言做某事是…的」，不定詞片語作真正主詞的常見句型。例如：It's easy for you to try.；It was hard for us to find a place to sit.

reading.q: What did the class set up at the school fair?
reading.ex: 文中提到「my class helped set up a game booth in the schoolyard」。

reading.q: How did the narrator use to feel about talking to customers?
reading.ex: 文中提到「I used to be too shy to talk to customers」。

reading.q: Who baked cookies for the fair?
reading.ex: 文中提到「Tina...baked dozens of cookies for the fair」。

reading.q: What did the booth's earnings go toward?
reading.ex: 文中提到「our booth earned enough money to buy new books for the library」。

reading.q: How did the narrator and classmates feel at the end of the day?
reading.ex: 文中提到「we were tired but proud」。

grammar.q: "I ______ be shy, but now I enjoy talking to people."
grammar.ex: used to + 原形動詞表示過去習慣、現在已不同，故用 used to be。

grammar.q: "This cake is ______ delicious ______ the one at the bakery."
grammar.ex: as + 形容詞 + as 表示「跟…一樣」。
否定句常用 not as...as，表示「不如」。

grammar.q: "It's easy ______ you to try this game."
grammar.ex: It's + 形容詞 + for + 某人 + to V句型中用 for 引出對象。

grammar.q: "It ______ hard for us to find a seat."
grammar.ex: 依文意描述過去發生的事，用過去式 was。

vocab.q: Which word means "驕傲的；自豪的"?
vocab.ex: proud 意指「驕傲的；自豪的」。

vocab.q: "She baked ______ of cookies for the fair." (選出意思為「好幾打的；許多的」片語)
vocab.ex: dozens of 意指「好幾打的；許多的」。
